about: The Mochi's own bag icons (Paolo's art, drawn by ChatGPT 2026-10-08): route29-official.sav given all seven Mochi (savedit --item), the start menu's BAG, the Items pocket: its first page shows the Health, Muscle, Resist, Genius, Clever and Swift Mochi, each drawn with its own icon -- every opaque pixel of its PNG, in its colours, found on the bottom screen (icon:) -- and not yet the Fresh-Start Mochi's; the page after shows the Fresh-Start Mochi's. konefr's art for all seven is a copy of none.png: with sImportedItemIcons at 0 for them they draw ITEM_NONE's question mark and every icon: expectation fails.
